_about: The ends of your Hive Mind that the health check watches: the places that carry the same thing and must agree. Read by system/ends-check.mjs. A new Hive Mind has one end beyond this computer, your private copy on GitHub, and the health check already watches that. Add an end here when a new place starts to carry the same thing: a page online (privatePage), a public site (publicSite), a copy kept by hand somewhere else (handCopies).
